description: This file defines the IEventHubDataAdapter interface, which specifies methods for adapting EventData from Azure Event Hubs into Orleans streaming infrastructure, including message conversion, stream position handling, and metadata extraction.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Converts EventData and associated metadata into a CachedMessage object.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Extracts the stream position from EventData based on partition.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the offset string from a CachedMessage.

methods.name: GetPartitionKey
methods.description: Obtains the partition key associated with a StreamId.
